biggest_catch: REJECT — Fitplay is dead: the app was unpublished from Google Play on May 1, 2025 (per AppBrain), the last update was February 14, 2024, and the official website is down (per review sites). There is nothing to sign up for.
catches: AppBrain: 'Fitplay: Apps & Rewards was unpublished from the Google Play store May 1, 2025' — the listing page now reads 'This app is currently not available on Google Play.'
Last update of the app was February 14, 2024 — over two and a half years without maintenance.
Review sites report the main Fitplay website is down and recent users could not download games or cash out — consistent with a shutdown.

Pre-shutdown reviews also reported the app stopped tracking gameplay, coins were not credited, and the company's Terms of Use disclaimed any guaranteed winnings ('the User has no right to the payout of a certain award').
The Fitplay copy lives on in the clone family (Coin Pop, Money Well, AppStation) — the company behind Fitplay appears defunct.
Same checklist bar as the Nielsen rejection (R0213): dead product, no official terms — stays unverified; rejection logged rather than forcing a positive.

c1.evidence: FAIL — Fitplay Company is defunct: app unpublished from Google Play May 1, 2025, official website down, no update since Feb 2024; no operating company remains behind the app.

c2.evidence: FAIL — no official terms are obtainable; the official site is down and the app is removed from the store.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee was ever charged (free app); moot since the product is dead.

c4.evidence: FAIL — no official source is obtainable: the site is down and the store listing is gone.

eligibility: None — the app cannot be installed from Google Play; no sign-up path exists.
notes: Hard product-death rejection, not a terms-concreteness rejection. Fitplay (package de.mcoins.fitplay, 5M+ downloads, 4.3 stars) was a real app that shut down. If the brand ever relaunches under an official site with published terms, re-check from scratch.

s1.note: No eligibility path — the app is unavailable.

s4.note: No weasel-word analysis — the product is dead.

s5.note: FAIL — no official site or listing exists.

s6.note: FAIL — no steps can be stated for a dead product.
